name: browser-tools
title_zh: 通过 Chrome 调试协议操控真实浏览器
tagline_zh: 测试前端、抓页面、点按钮，不用写 Selenium。直接连上你正在看的 Chrome，像真人一样操作。
tagline_en: Drive the Chrome you already have open. No Selenium, no WebDriver — just CDP for real clicks, typing, and page.
desc_en: Interactive browser automation via Chrome DevTools Protocol. Use when you need to interact with web pages, test frontends, or when user interaction with a visible browser is required.
why_zh: 走 CDP 直连，不另起浏览器实例，能复用登录态和用户配置；操作可见、可中断，适合需要人工确认的交互场。
why_en: Attaches to your live Chrome via CDP — reuses sessions and cookies, shows every action, and lets you step in when needed.
limit_zh: 只支持本机 Chrome/Chromium，且需以 --remote-debugging-port 启动。
limit_en: Local Chrome/Chromium only, launched with --remote-debugging-port. No captcha/popup handling, no multi-tab orchestration, no test reports — just.
